blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Streaming speech recognizers output a word only after the speaker has finished it, typically 90-400 ms later. For a voice agent every millisecond counts: the sooner the words are outputted, the sooner the agent can start a search or plan its reply. We present Earlybird, a 29M-parameter streaming recognizer (16.8 MB at 4 bits). Earlybird learns from audio cut off at random points, including partway through a word, and is asked to predict every word that is due by then in full, plus a guess of the next two words. Its raw token probabilities give a confidence for every word including the one still being spoken. On clean audiobook speech (LibriSpeech test-clean), the median word is predicted correctly 90 ms before the speaker finishes it, while released streaming models get it 90 to 400 ms after it ends. Earlybird is the earliest on all six test sets we time, covering audiobooks, TED talks, public speech, earnings calls, and synthetic speech. On the same audiobooks, 69% of words are predicted correctly before they end, against 3-25% for the other models. For words still being spoken, confidence is calibrated, with an expected calibration error (ECE) of 3.7 to 5.5. On the eight English Open ASR Leaderboard sets, it is more accurate than Moonshine Tiny on every set and roughly ties Whistle, a model of the same size.
blocks.zh: 流式语音识别器只在演讲者完成后输出出一个单词,一般是90-400 ms后. 对于一个语音代理每毫秒计数:单词越快被输出,代理可以越快开始搜索或计划其回复. 我们呈现出一个29M参数的流线识别器"早鸟"(Earlybird) (16.8 MB at 4 bits). 早期的鸟从随机点被切断的音频中学习,包括通过一个单词的分道扬镳,被要求预测到那时到期的每个单词,并加上对后两个单词的猜测. 其原始的象征可能性为每个词,包括仍在讲的词,提供了信心。 在干净的音频书语音(英语:LibriSpeech test-clean)上,中位词在扬声器完成前被正确预测为90 ms,而放出流线模型则在结束后得到90到400 ms. Earlybird是我们时间所有六个测试集中最早的, 包括音频书籍,TED演讲,公共演讲,收入呼吁,和合成演讲。 在同一本音频书上,69%的词在结束之前的预测是正确的,而其他模型的预测为3-25%. 对于仍在说话的词,信心被校正,预期校正错误(ECE)为3.7至5.5. 在英国八套公开ASR Lordboard上,它比"月光"(Moonshine Tiny)在每套节目上更准确,并且大致联系了同大小的模型"Whistle".

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
A spoken request to a voice agent reaches the agent as text. With a streaming recognizer, each
word of that text arrives a few hundred milliseconds after the speaker finished saying it.
For a voice agent, that delay is time it could have spent starting a search or
planning a reply while the speaker is still talking.
blocks.zh:
语音代理的口头请求作为文本送达代理. 每个都有一个流线识别器
在演讲者说完话后,几百毫秒后,文字就传到了。
对于一个语音代理来说,这种延迟是它本可以花时间开始搜索或
准备在演讲人还在说话的时候回答

blocks.en:
People listening to speech do not wait for the end of a word to know what it is. Most words can
be recognized from their first few phonemes in context, and the next word is often predictable.
We ask whether a small on-device recognizer can do the same: predict each word from its first
sounds, guess the word after it, and say how sure it is.
blocks.zh:
听言之人,不等一字之终而知之. 大多数词可以
在上下文中从最初几个电话中识别出来,下一个词往往可以预测。
我们问一个小型的在线识别器能否做同样的事情:从第一个词来预测每个词
听起来,猜猜后面的词, 并说它有多确定。

blocks.en:
Earlybird trains on utterances cut off at random 80 ms steps, which is exactly the position a
streaming model is in at each update. The target is every word that is due at that point,
written in full even if its audio has only begun, followed by an end marker and the next two
words of the transcript as a guess. Because the targets for successive cut points only ever extend
one another, the model also learns not to output what it will later take back. Every word it outputs
carries the product of its token probabilities as a confidence.
blocks.zh:

每次更新时都会输入流线模型。 目标就是每个词 届时,
完全写入,即使其音频刚刚开始,然后是结尾标记和下两个标记
笔录中的文字作为猜测。 因为连续切出点的目标 只会延长
互相之间,模型也学会了不输出它日后会收回的东西. 每个字,它输出
带着它的象征概率的产物作为信心。

blocks.en:

they end, with no change to the architecture and no future audio

with their own code, on six test sets with per-word timings (Section 5.2 ). • A 16.8 MB 4-bit release scored on the Open ASR Leaderboard’s English sets
(Section 5.3 ). • Evidence that the model’s raw confidence is calibrated for words still being spoken and

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Zink et al. [3] train an offline encoder-decoder to predict words in masked audio at
the end of an utterance (“predictive speech recognition”) and report useful predictions up to
about 300 ms before the utterance ends. Yusuf et al. [4] define speculative speech
recognition, in which a language model prompted with audio runs ahead of a streaming recognizer. Baumann and Schlangen [5] predict the remaining duration of the current word for an
incremental dialogue system. Earlybird differs in putting prediction inside a small streaming recognizer,
training on random cut points rather than only the utterance end, and reporting calibration and
stability alongside earliness.
blocks.zh:
津克等编. [3] 培训离线编码器-解码器,以预测蒙面音频中的字词。
并报告截至2000年6月30日的有用预测。
语音结束前约300ms。 约瑟夫等. [4] 界定投机性言论
识别,其中带有音频激发的语言模型运行在流体识别器之前. Baumann和Schlangen [5] 预测当前单词的剩余持续时间。
渐进式对话系统。 早期的鸟类在将预测放入小流体识别器方面有所不同,
培训随机切出点,而不是只进行词端,并报告校正和
稳定与听力。

blocks.en:
Chang et al. [6] prefetch downstream responses from partial hypotheses and save about
200 ms when the final result matches. Schwarz et al. [7] predict whole utterances
from partial ones to cut assistant latency. Both depend on how early and how stable partial text
is, which Earlybird improves.

最终结果匹配时为200ms. 施瓦兹等. [7] 预测整个言论
从部分到减少助手的延迟。 两者都取决于部分文本的早期和稳定性
是,这早鸟改进。

blocks.en:
Work such as FastEmit [ 8 ] reduces how long a transducer waits before emitting a
token, and LocalAgreement [ 9 ] turns an offline model into a streaming
one by committing text that consecutive passes agree on. These methods reduce delay toward the end
of the word. Earlybird aims to predict the word correctly before it ends.

标志, 本地协议 [9] 将一个离线模型变成流线
一是承诺通过连续商定的案文。 这些方法减少了延迟到最后
说到做到 早期的鸟想在结束之前正确预测这个词.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Starting point
blocks.zh: 3.1 起点

blocks.en:
Earlybird starts from Moonshine streaming Tiny [ 2 ] (34M parameters, MIT
license), an encoder-decoder that consumes 80 ms audio chunks. We cut its vocabulary to 19,007
tokens: those that occur in a large body of English text (our training transcripts), plus every
single-character token, so any word can still be spelled out. This brings it to 29M parameters,
and the cut model scores within 0.4 WER points of the original on every test set, including
TED-LIUM and Earnings-22, which are not in its training data. The released runtime holds each word back until roughly 300 ms of audio past it has
been heard. Earlybird decodes the full transcript at every step with no hold-back.

The guessed words follow the end-of-text token, so a decoder that stops at end-of-text produces
only the transcript. Continuing past it produces the guess.

blocks.en: 3.3 Learning from the teacher only where it is right
blocks.zh: 3.3 只在适当之处向教师学习

blocks.en:
The original Moonshine Tiny also serves as a teacher through a distillation loss, applied only at
token positions where the teacher’s top choice matches the label. Where the teacher is wrong or
unsure, its probability is spread over several words, and matching it there taught Earlybird to do the
same. With the loss at every position, the guessed words came out less decisive, with their
probability spread over several candidates instead of committed to one.
blocks.zh:

老师的顶级选择与标签匹配的标志位置 。 如果老师错了或者
不肯定,它的概率 分布在几个字, 并匹配那里教 早鸟做
一样 随着每个位置的损失, 猜想的词 出来不那么决定性,
可能性分布在几个候选人身上,而不是致力于一个候选人。

blocks.en: 3.4 Padding frames
blocks.zh: 3.4 铺设框架

blocks.en:
At each step the encoder also sees three frames computed from silence after the audio heard so
far. This uses no future audio. It lets the model finish a word as if the speaker might have
stopped. Training with padding frames moved the median word from − 50 -50 ms to − 90 -90 ms on
LibriSpeech test-clean (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh:
在每一个步骤,编码器还看到三帧 从沉默中计算 音频听到后
很远 这不使用未来的音频 。 它让模特儿说完一个词 就像演讲者可能说过
停下来。 用垫框进行的培训将中位词从-50-50米移到-90-90米
LibriSpeech测试清洁(表5).

blocks.en: 3.5 Quantization
blocks.zh: 3.5 量化

blocks.en:
Quantization-aware training brings the weights to 4 bits, with the audio front end kept at 8 bits.
The weights file is 16.8 MB (17.6 MB with the trimmed tokenizer and configuration).
blocks.zh:
分量-意识训练使分量达到4比特,音频前端保持为8比特.
权重文件为16.8 MB (17.6 MB 有修剪的活化剂和配置).

blocks.en: 3.6 Confidence
blocks.zh: 3.6 信心

blocks.en:
For each word on screen, the confidence is the product of the probabilities of its tokens in the
decoder pass that produced it. Guessed words get their confidence the same way. There is no
temperature scaling or other calibration step.
blocks.zh:
对于屏幕上的每个词,信心是其符号在屏幕上的概率的产物.
解码器传出它。 猜想中的言语得到他们的信心的方式相同. 没有
温度缩放或其他校正步骤。

blocks.en: 3.7 Data and schedule
blocks.zh: 3.7 数据和时间表

blocks.en:
Training uses LibriSpeech [ 10 ] (960 h, published Montreal Forced
Aligner [ 11 ] word times), about 300 h of People’s Speech
clean [ 12 ] with word times from a wav2vec 2.0 CTC aligner, and about 25 h of
synthetic Kokoro [ 13 ] speech whose phoneme durations give exact word times, sampled with
weights 1:3:3:3:1 (LibriSpeech clean-100, clean-360, other-500, People’s Speech, Kokoro; the first
stage below uses the four real sets only, 1:3:3:3). Real
transcripts are kept only when a teacher (Moonshine Medium) writes exactly the reference words.
No non-commercial corpora are used for training. Training ran in four stages on a single GPU with
batch 48, all with the KD term: 10k steps of streaming-cut training after the vocabulary cut (learning
rate 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} ), 20k steps of prefix training with two guessed words ( 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} ), 5k
steps with the padding frames ( 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} ), and 5k steps of quantization-aware training at
4 bits with the front end at 8 bits ( 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} ).

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation setup
blocks.zh: 4. 评价设置

blocks.en:
LibriSpeech test-clean and test-other, TED-LIUM 3 [ 14 ] ,
a held-out People’s Speech set, Earnings-22 [ 15 ] , and 500 held-out WikiText
sentences synthesized with Kokoro using two voices not seen in training. Word end times come from
the Montreal Forced Aligner (LibriSpeech), Kokoro’s durations (synthetic), or our wav2vec 2.0
aligner, whose word ends fall within a median of 4–8 ms of Kokoro’s and 26 ms of MFA’s.

接合器,其词尾中位数为科科罗的4至8毫秒和外交部的26毫秒。

blocks.en:
Each recognizer is fed audio in order in 80 ms chunks and every change to
its on-screen text is logged against the audio clock. Processing time is not added for any model,
so the numbers measure what each model decides to output, not how fast the hardware runs it. For
each reference word we record the time from which it is predicted correctly : the word is in the
output, spelled correctly and in the right location, and stays unchanged until the end of the utterance. Its word latency is that time relative to the word’s acoustic end; negative means before the
speaker finishes it. We also count revisions (words taken back) per spoken word and word error rate
(WER) of the final transcript. Confidence is scored with expected calibration error
(ECE) [ 16 ] over 10 equal-width bins. Every model is scored on the same utterances within each set. Unless stated otherwise, Earlybird
results are for the full-precision model; the 4-bit release is in Tables 3 and 5 .

blocks.en:
Released models run with their own code: Moonshine Tiny with its official
streaming runtime (quantized); Whistle [ 17 ] (55M parameters, 16.9 MB) in the Cactus
engine’s live mode; and Whisper base.en [ 18 ] (74M) re-decoded on all audio so
far every 0.48 s, with its raw output shown. For accuracy and on LibriSpeech clean we also run
Whisper tiny.en (39M) and small.en (244M) the same way.

Table 1 shows that Earlybird predicts the median word correctly before the speaker finishes it

The subsets are small, but the medians hold on full test sets: Earlybird’s median word latency is − 90 -90 ms on all 2,620 LibriSpeech clean utterances, − 67 -67 ms on all 1,155 TED-LIUM utterances (Moonshine Tiny runtime: +296 ms on the same 1,155), − 63 -63 ms on 500 People’s Speech utterances (+301 ms) and − 43 -43 ms on 1,000 Earnings-22 utterances (+308 ms). (tiny.en), +90 ms (base.en) and +80 ms (small.en).

Earlybird remains the earliest model at every noise level (Table 4 ) and is more
accurate than Moonshine Tiny throughout. Its accuracy degrades most under background speech: at
10 dB, its WER is 32.0% against 8.9% for Whisper base.

10分贝,其WER为32.0%,而Whisper碱为8.9%.

On one CPU thread (Intel Xeon Platinum 8488C), Earlybird takes 39 ms on average per 80 ms step
(p95 64 ms), about twice as fast as real time, against 47 ms for Moonshine Tiny decoded the same way.

points on every test set.

blocks.en:
A word output early is only useful if the agent knows when to trust it. Figure 3 and
Table 6 show that Earlybird’s raw confidence is calibrated for the hardest case, a word the
speaker has not finished: ECE is 3.7–5.5 points, and words output at confidence ≥ 0.9 \geq 0.9 are right
91–96% of the time. Guessed next words are calibrated more tightly (ECE 0.8–3.7). On a set of
spoken commands outside the training domain (SLURP), calibration is worse: ECE 8.8 for words still
being spoken.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 限制

blocks.en:
• Accuracy. Whisper base, 2.5 times larger, is more accurate on every test set
except LibriSpeech clean, most of all with background chatter. • Revisions. Outputting words early means taking more words back than models that wait,
especially on spontaneous and noisy speech. • Guesses are rare. At confidence ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 , about one word in seven (12–16%) is
guessed right before it ends. Most early words come from the transcript itself. • Timing references. Word end times come from forced aligners, which carry their
own error of tens of milliseconds. The synthetic set gives exact times and agrees. • English only , and calibration degrades on out-of-domain command speech.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
Training a small streaming recognizer on audio cut off at random points, with whole words as
targets, is enough to make it predict words correctly before the speaker finishes them, with a confidence an
application can act on. The resulting model is 16.8 MB, runs about twice as fast as real time on one CPU
thread, and is about as accurate as other models of its size. On LibriSpeech clean, its median word
is predicted correctly 90 ms before it ends, while released streaming models get it 90–400 ms
after, and it is the earliest model on all six test sets. 69% of audiobook words are predicted
correctly before they end, and for words still being spoken its confidence is calibrated, with an
expected calibration error of 3.7 to 5.5. On the eight English Open ASR Leaderboard sets it is more accurate than
Moonshine Tiny on every set and roughly ties Whistle, a model of the same size.
Weights and a loader are released under the MIT license at https://huggingface.co/sahilmahendrakar/Earlybird-29M .

训练一个小流音识别器 随机切断音频, 整个词作为
足够让它在演讲者完成发言之前 正确预测文字,充满信心
应用程序可以采取行动。 产生的型号为 16.8 MB,运行速度约为一个CPU的实时两倍
线程,并大致与大小的其他模型一样准确。 在 LibriSpeech 上,它的中值单词
在结束前正确预测了90 ms, 而发布的流线模型得到90–400 ms
之后,它是所有六个测试集中最早的模型. 预测了69%的音书词
在他们结束之前正确无误,对于仍然在说话的话,它的信心被校正,用一种
预期校正错误3.7至5.5。 在8个英语开放的ASR导板上,它比
月光线 每一套小的 和大致连接的Whistle, 一个大小相同的模型。
